design: Female, mid 60s, a retired schoolteacher from the Bronx, New York, an older woman's warm, full, low alto voice, commanding and unhurried, kind but firm, a voice that carries across a room without shouting, close-mic, clean dry studio audio, natural and conversational, not an announcer.
refText: Alright, everybody, settle down. I taught science for thirty-one years, so I know what not listening sounds like. Soup is at six. Bring a bowl, bring a friend, and bring some patience.
